export_workflow.step_1: author selects article_id + review_status target (must be REVISED or above to export)
export_workflow.step_2: author selects format (Markdown / CSL JSON / BibTeX)
export_workflow.step_3: export_specs renders article content into target format (read-only, no auto-generation)
export_workflow.step_4: research_team downloads exported file (manual, no API)
export_workflow.step_5: exported file is marked with v0.8 watermark: "Generated by SHUGE DH Research Platform v0.8 · READ-ONLY ID LINK"

boundary_invariants: SHALL NOT auto-generate article 正文 (only render from existing draft paragraphs)
SHALL NOT change Citation ID format (SHUGE:p<post_id>:<page_seq>) in any export
SHALL NOT expose full_text of any work/institution in any export
SHALL include Conan Xin Archive Bridge footer in every export
SHALL NOT export body_excerpt > 200 chars from v0.7 paragraphs
